name: vixel-server-runtime
description: Runtime dependency set for the Vixel server Docker image (Node ABI, no Electron). Versions are pinned to the ones the desktop app ships (see the repo's package-lock.json) so search behaviour stays identical. Installed with `npm ci --omit=dev` inside the image's deps stage; the lockfile is regenerated with `npm install --package-lock-only` in this directory whenever versions here change.
